python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for convertible foreign currencies (in millions of dollars) for CY 1963-1977
data = [212, 432, 781, 1321, 2345, 3528, 2781, 629, 276, 241, 8, 5, 80, 320, 18]

n = len(data)
print(f"n = {n}")
print(f"Data: {data}")

# Calculate mean
mean = sum(data) / n
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation
# Using sample std formula: sqrt(Σ(xi - x̄)^2 / (n-1))
variance = sum((x - mean)**2 for x in data) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Sample Standard Deviation: {std_dev}")

# Calculate Fisher-Pearson adjusted skewness coefficient
# G1 = [n/(n-1)(n-2)] * Σ[(xi - x̄)^3] / s^3

# First compute the sum of cubed deviations
sum_cubed_dev = sum((x - mean)**3 for x in data)
print(f"Sum of cubed deviations: {sum_cubed_dev}")

# Calculate the coefficient
coef = n / ((n - 1) * (n - 2))
print(f"Coefficient n/((n-1)(n-2)): {coef}")

# Calculate skewness
skewness = coef * sum_cubed_dev / (std_dev ** 3)
print(f"Fisher-Pearson Adjusted Skewness: {skewness}")

# Round to nearest thousandths
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(skewness, 3)}")
EOF
